description: Retrieves a saved GigHQ job application, candidate profile data, and the most relevant Career Journal evidence for assessing role fit. Career evidence is ranked by job keywords, competency coverage, evidence quality, recency, and diversity; the default is 20 entries, grouped by competency bucket (career_journal.competency_rollup) to make coverage and gaps easy to spot. This read-only tool supplies evidence and retrieval metadata only. It does not assess the candidate, calculate a fit score, or modify records. If the job description is missing, it returns the application link and a substantive/recent evidence fallback.

application_uuid.description: UUID of the saved GigHQ job application.

career_entry_limit.description: Maximum Career Journal entries to return (default 20, max 50).

name: get_job_fit_evidence
